title: Project inventory and capacity CAS interface

conditions.description: Please provide your current pinned project capacity CAS source/ref, typed admission seam and file ownership, including expected inventory head/generation and occupancy inputs. W16 inventory must bind complete baseline and all post-barrier launch events to the exact same project CAS; missing or unverified coverage remains HOLD. Identify a compatible atomic handoff without caller-asserted completeness.
conditions.evidence: Frozen accepted source e3430a0806c77078344b23d17095971a5fe2edde, Client/Modules/ProjectCapacityAdmission.fs: internal reserve binding actor operation effect role roleVersion generation; state includes project/ledger/epoch, total, role map, entries with original effect/operation/owner/role/version/generation/status. read and change are private, LedgerStore.transact wraps reserve. There is no inventory head/generation or all-send baseline authority and no same-transaction injection point. Capacity files and dedicated tests are W21-owned; inventory is W16-owned. A future interface must validate W16 verified baseline/fence and post-barrier events using the exact transact snapshot, combine changes in that commit, recompute on CAS retry, and fail closed for unknown; a separate read cannot prove this. No claim of integration.
conditions.reason: No compatible atomic handoff is available in frozen seam: reserve owns its transaction and has no inventory snapshot/fence parameter. Revised implementation scope awaits Lead reconciliation of pinned assignment.
